inputs.share_count_basis: Q3-2026 weighted-average DILUTED shares, derived from the Q3 2026 6-K: nine-month weighted diluted 633.066m x 3 less H1 weighted diluted 634.487m x 2 = 630.2m (Q3 basic on the same derivation 608.6m; dilutive awards ~22m). Held FLAT because SBC is fully expensed in the OpCo flows. The 2.375% convertible notes were redeemed in cash in Q3, so the prior version's convert double-charge is gone. Repurchases after 30-Sep (~US$240m to 10-Nov under the first US$1bn program) are NOT reflected - mildly conservative.
inputs.net_debt_basis: SURPLUS corporate net cash only, NOT gross cash; same ring-fence basis as the prior version, refreshed to 30-Sep-2026 (Q3 2026 6-K EX-99.1). Unrestricted cash $2,905.3m + short-term investments $5,112.8m LESS $1,100m liquidity reserve backing Monee deposits payable ($5,358.5m x ~20%; was $900m on $4,285m), LESS $1,100m escrow backing reserve (escrow payables + customer advances $3,152.8m vs restricted cash $2,327.2m - filed shortfall ~$826m; the extra is deliberate conservatism), LESS corporate debt $1,216.5m (borrowings $454.2m current + $762.3m non-current; convertible notes now nil). Deposits payable and escrow payables are NOT net debt - they are Monee operating funding and the loan book they fund is valued inside the Monee model. NOT credited: long-term investments $3,272.9m, up $1,384m since Dec-2025 while short-term investments fell $1,300m and net investment purchases were only $134m - i.e. liquidity migrated from short- to long-dated instruments. Holding the prior basis therefore understates surplus cash by up to ~$2/share from that migration alone (and ~$5/share if all long-term investments were liquid); left out deliberately pending a 20-F note split between time deposits/debt securities and strategic equity stakes.
inputs.last_fcf_basis: OpCo (Shopee + Garena + corporate) FY2025 owner FCF, component-built: seg adj EBITDA $2,400m (Shopee 880.6 + Garena 1,700 - unallocated ~180) - allocated SBC $531m - D&A $421m = EBIT $1,448m; x(1-26%) = $1,071m NOPAT; + D&A - actual capex $513.8m + WC capture $377m. NOT reported_fcf - sbc - interest_income ($3,554.6m): that consolidated figure is distorted by Monee - its pre-provision earnings sit in OCF while the ~$3.8bn FY2025 loan-book build sits in INVESTING, so reported FCF overstates distributable group cash. Monee is carved out and valued separately on distributable earnings.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 20-F cash-flow add-back $625.0m (XBRL ShareBasedCompensation). No combined 'SBC incl. equity-award taxes' figure published. Allocated 85% to OpCo, 15% to Monee, by headcount/revenue judgment (unchanged). 2026 run-rate from the adjusted-EBITDA reconciliation: Q1 $133.3m, Q2 $131.9m, Q3 $132.1m = $397.4m for nine months, DOWN 15% YoY while revenue grew 46% - about 1.7% of group revenue, which is what re-anchors the forward path to 1.8% of OpCo revenue.
inputs.interest_income_note: FY2025 consolidated interest income excluded from the flows (the component build starts from segment adj EBITDA, which excludes it); its source asset - the surplus cash pile - is in the bridge instead, per the excluded-income/matching-asset rule. Interest earned on the ~$2.0bn ring-fenced reserves is stripped but the reserves are NOT in the bridge: deliberate conservatism.
inputs.buyback_note: FY2025 $14.5m + nine months 2026 $743m actually spent (cash-flow statement); US$997.2m / 11.1m shares cumulative by 10-Nov-2026, completing the first US$1bn program. A second US$1bn authorization was approved 9-Nov-2026 (authorized is not spent - not counted). Flat count is a FUNDED convention here: repurchases are running at ~1.9x the SBC run-rate.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-11-18T21:00:02Z regular close (Yahoo regularMarketTime; not an after-hours print)
inputs.wacc_rationale: OpCo WACC 11.5%, USD flows: rf 4.3% (US 10yr) + beta ~1.35 x ERP 4.5% = ~10.4%, + ~1.1pp blended EM country-risk/FX-translation premium (revenue earned in IDR/VND/THB/PHP/MYR/BRL/TWD, reported USD; a strong dollar mechanically compresses USD growth). Garena Free Fire single-title concentration and TikTok competitive risk are priced IN THE SCENARIOS, not stacked on WACC (charge risk once); WACC is identical across scenarios. Monee cost of equity 14.5%: rf 4.3% + 1.5 x 4.5% ERP = ~11.1% + ~2.4pp EM unsecured-consumer-credit premium (unseasoned book growing 62% YoY, deposit-funded, multi-jurisdiction rate-cap/regulatory exposure) + ~1pp for the off-Shopee/Brazil mix shift. Capitalized at CoE because distributable earnings are post-funding-cost; Monee's deposits are never in net debt.
inputs.lease_treatment: US GAAP (ASC 842): operating lease cost is already fully inside opex/adj-EBITDA, so flows need NO adjustment and operating lease liabilities ($1,906m at 30-Jun-2026) are EXCLUDED from the debt bridge - including both would double-charge. Finance leases are immaterial ($45.4m at FY2025) and ignored.
inputs.notes: MODEL: sum-of-the-parts, unchanged from the 2026-08-26 build (dcf-methods routing: Sea straddles two rows, so the parts are valued separately and summed). (1) OpCo = Shopee + Garena + Other Services + corporate: 10-year component owner-FCF DCF, FY0 revenue $19,146.8m (group $22,938.5m less Monee $3,791.6m), WACC 11.5%. (2) Monee: embedded EM consumer lender ($12.6bn principal outstanding at 30-Sep-2026, +60% YoY; funded by $5.36bn deposits + $3.15bn escrow) valued on DISTRIBUTABLE earnings = post-tax earnings less equity retained at 15% of loan-book growth, at a 14.5% cost of equity. (3) Surplus corporate net cash added once, in the bridge. A single consolidated owner-FCF DCF was considered and rejected again: reported FCF is not owner cash while the loan-book build sits in investing ($4.4bn in nine months) and its deposit funding in financing. THIS IS AN UPDATE - see `reconciliation` and `update_notes`. The model still discounts FY2026 as a full year-1 flow although ten and a half months of it have elapsed; left as is for comparability with the prior version (conservative by most of a year of discount unwind; it reverses when FY0 rolls to FY2026 at the March-2027 results). EBITDA basis: the margin path is on the OLD bookings-inclusive definition of Garena adjusted EBITDA (Sea now excludes the deferred-revenue effect; the 9M-2026 effect of $278m is added back to the reported segment figures to stay on the prior basis). NCI of $150.2m (~$0.24/share) not deducted - immaterial. Realisation haircut: not applicable (no mainland-China operations).

historical_growth.notes: EPS and owner-FCF CAGRs are null: FY2020-22 bases are negative (owner FCF FY2022 -$2,801m). Consolidated owner-FCF series (reported FCF - SBC - interest income): FY2023 $821.7m, FY2024 $1,877.6m, FY2025 $3,554.6m (2yr CAGR ~108% - base-effect, not a projection input, and inflated by the loan-book distortion described in last_fcf_basis). Equity CAGR (29.2%) exceeds revenue CAGR (22.6%) by 29% - below the 30% flag threshold, but note equity growth is inflated by $2.1bn of convertible-note conversions FY2024-25, not just retained earnings. Selected 22.6% is the screener's forward proxy only; the model itself uses an OpCo path fading 38% -> 4.5% anchored to H1-2026 actuals (+47.4% group) and FY2026 guidance (Shopee GMV ~25%, Shopee adj EBITDA >= $1bn).

base.narrative: Shopee holds its #1 position in a Shopee/TikTok Shop duopoly and keeps trading margin for growth as guided: OpCo (Shopee + Garena + other + corporate) revenue +40.5% in FY2026 (9M actual +40%) fading to 4.5% by Y10; adj EBITDA margin 10.1% in FY2026 (Shopee ~$1.0bn, Garena ~$1.95bn on a bookings basis, Other Services/Sea Cloud losses ~-$0.25bn) maturing to 17% as ad take-rate and logistics density build. Garena bookings growth has already slowed to +5.9% (Q3) - the titles age, no successor hit assumed. The FY2026 capex step-up (PP&E purchases doubling to ~6% of OpCo revenue: logistics plus the Sea Cloud / AI-infrastructure push) fades to 2.8% by Y8 as the build-out completes. Monee's book grows ~51% in FY2026 then fades to 5%; post-tax ROA starts at 7.0% (not the 8.5% assumed in August - provisions are outgrowing the book) and compresses to 5.0%; 15% of book growth is retained as equity before anything is distributable.

bull.narrative: All three engines keep firing: TikTok Shop rationalizes subsidies, Shopee compounds GMV in the high-20s with ad monetization closing toward mature-peer take rates (OpCo margin to 19%), Garena lands durable monetization across Free Fire and Arena of Valor, the infrastructure build-out earns its keep, and Monee's credit quality holds as the book seasons (ROA fades only from 7.2% to 6.0%, book compounds faster into Brazil and the Philippines). No value is ascribed to Sea Cloud revenue or to a Monee listing premium. Terminal growth 3.5%.

bear.narrative: Three axes: (1) TikTok Shop (+Tokopedia, ~66% of Shopee's GMV and gaining in Vietnam/Thailand) reignites the subsidy war - Shopee S&M already grew 64% YoY in Q3 - so OpCo margin stalls at 9.5-12.5% and growth fades to GDP by Y5 while Garena's recovery rolls over. (2) The Monee credit cycle arrives in 2027: the unseasoned 60%-growth book seasons badly (Q3 provisions +82% vs book +60%, NPL 1.3% from 1.1%), ROA collapses to 3.5% before a partial rebuild to 4.0%, and book growth is constrained to single digits. (3) Sea Cloud / AI infrastructure keeps capex at 5-6% of OpCo revenue through Y4 without a matching revenue stream, fading only to 3.0%. Terminal growth 2%, TV cap 15x.

entry_price.formula: (sum OpCo FCF_t/1.15^t + OpCo TV@hurdle/1.15^10 + sum Monee distributable_t/1.15^t + Monee TV@hurdle/1.15^10 + surplus net cash) / shares. Every terminal value is rebuilt at the hurdle: min(Gordon@15%, cap x FCF_N) for OpCo, min(Gordon@15%, exit-P/E cap x earnings_N) for Monee.
entry_price.prior_version_error: The prior file's entry prices (bear 28.01 / base 56.10 / bull 78.98, weighted 54.80) and its required-return table OMITTED the Monee equity value entirely - the 2026-09-01 terminal-value correction rebuilt the OpCo leg only. On the prior drivers the correct figures were 34.53 / 70.07 / 98.82, weighted 68.37. The numbers here include Monee.

required_return_table.note: Each row re-discounts the OpCo flows and rebuilds the OpCo terminal value at that row's rate (min(Gordon@r, cap x FCF_N)). Monee stays at its own 14.5% cost of equity for rows below 14.5% and moves to the row rate above it, so the 11.5% row equals the base intrinsic value and the 15% row equals the base entry price.

sensitivity.note: Base-case OpCo re-run at each WACC x terminal-growth pair; Monee equity value (at 14.5% CoE) and surplus net cash held constant. Rows = WACC, columns = terminal growth.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: UNCHANGED at 25/50/25. Bear stays at 25% (house default 15%): the TikTok subsidy axis and the Monee credit axis are independent and both high-severity, and Q3 moved the credit axis from hypothetical to visible (NPL 1.3%, provisions +82%). That evidence is charged ONCE, in the drivers - the base Monee ROA path was cut and the bear capex path now carries the Sea Cloud risk - rather than again in the weights. Base 50%. Bull stays at 25% (default 35%): it needs subsidy rationalization AND Garena durability AND benign credit seasoning AND a capex build-out that pays for itself. What would move the weights: two more quarters of provisions growing >1.3x the book or NPL above 1.5% (bear to 30-35%); a disclosed Sea Cloud capex budget above ~$2bn/yr with no external revenue (bear up); provisions decelerating below book growth for two quarters (bull back toward 35%).
probability_weighted.band_note: Band position is negative: the price sits BELOW the house (SBC fully expensed) value, not between house and street. In August it sat above the street ceiling. The market is no longer paying for SBC treatment at all; the disagreement with this model is now about Monee credit quality, the capex step-up and Shopee margin maturity.

reconciliation.bridge_note: Each step is the change in weighted IV from applying that change alone, in the order listed, on top of the steps before it; the prior model was first reproduced to the cent (43.45 / 95.81 / 139.28, weighted 93.59) with the same code. No methodology change and no change to WACC, cost of equity, terminal assumptions or weights. The price move (-44% since the prior version) does not enter intrinsic value; it turns a -24% weighted downside into a +33% weighted upside.
reconciliation.entry_price_note: The entry-price change is NOT comparable like-for-like: the prior published figures omitted Monee (see entry_price.prior_version_error). Against the corrected prior weighted entry price of $68.37 the new $65.53 is a $2.84 reduction, the same causes as the IV bridge.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Sum of the parts: Shopee + Garena on component-built owner FCF with SBC fully expensed and the share count flat; Monee as a lender on distributable earnings at a 14.5% cost of equity; surplus corporate cash once, after ring-fencing deposit and escrow backing. Since August the business has delivered on growth while three things got worse for owners - capex doubled, the tax rate rose, and Monee's provisions outran its book - and the share price has fallen far more than those facts take off intrinsic value.
valuation_philosophy.house_basis: SBC fully expensed (FY2025 $625m was ~40% of net income; the 2026 run-rate is ~$530m and falling as a share of revenue), share count flat at 630.2m diluted, buybacks value-neutral and currently funded at ~1.9x the SBC run-rate. Street basis reported alongside; the price now sits below the house value.
valuation_philosophy.why_sotp: One consolidated DCF was rejected because reported FCF ($4.5bn FY2025) is not owner cash: Monee's pre-provision earnings sit in OCF while the ~$3.8bn loan-book build sits in investing and its deposit funding in financing. An FCF DCF simultaneously OVERSTATES Monee (ignores the cash its growth consumes) and cannot price its credit risk. Shopee+Garena are valued on component-built owner FCF; Monee on distributable earnings (post-tax earnings less 15%-of-book-growth equity retention) at a 14.5% CoE; surplus corporate cash counted once, in the bridge, after ring-fencing deposit/escrow backing.
conservatisms: Only $4.6bn of the $8.0bn cash + short-term investments credited as surplus; $3.3bn of long-term investments not credited at all
Interest on the ring-fenced reserves stripped without crediting the asset
Sea Cloud carried as capex and losses with zero revenue in every scenario
FY2026 still discounted as a full year although the valuation date is mid-November
Post-September buybacks (~3m shares) not taken out of the count
All borrowings treated as corporate debt although part funds the credit business
key_risks_to_valuation: Monee credit seasoning: provisions +82% YoY against a book +60%, NPL 1.3% - the base ROA path already steps down, the bear takes it to 3.5%

Capex: the base assumes the FY2026 step-up is a build-out that fades; on the bear's slower fade the base value is ~$3.5/share lower, and if ~6% of OpCo revenue is permanent it is ~$19.5/share lower (base $94 -> ~$74)
TikTok Shop subsidy re-escalation: Shopee sales and marketing +60% YoY in Q3
Garena bookings growth has slowed to mid-single digits; two mature titles, no successor
Surplus-cash definition: the long-term-investment migration could be worth +$2 to +$5/share that this model does not count
Founder control and an unsized new strategic pivot (Sea Cloud) announced by staff memo
valuation_philosophy.what_would_change_the_call: Up: provisions decelerating below book growth for two quarters, a disclosed capex envelope that confirms a fade, or Shopee's mature margin evidencing above ~17%. Down: NPL above 1.5%, capex guided above ~$2bn/yr for FY2027, or Shopee adj EBITDA slipping below the $1bn/yr run-rate.
